name: gep-scm-tests-root
description: Root orchestrator for GEP SCM test suites (API + UI).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ./api install && npm --prefix ./ui install && npm --prefix ./observability install && npx --prefix ./ui playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:observability
